title: Business Operations and Growth Lead, Asia
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community you will join:

The Chief Business Officer (CBO) organization drives Airbnb's growth and expansion around the world, commercializing our new and existing businesses and executing our global strategy in the market. The Global Markets team sits within CBO and makes sure Airbnb is locally relevant everywhere we operate, helping regions plan and execute growth across supply, demand, and the surfaces our communities use.

Asia is one of the largest growth opportunities in that portfolio and one of the most complex regions to run: Japan, Korea, India and Southeast Asia sit at very different stages of maturity, with distinct competitive sets, regulatory contexts and consumer behaviour. Over the past year the region has built a new operating system across its Asia and APAC forums, and taken growth levers such as host-funded promotions from single-market pilots to programs running across more than a dozen markets. That growth has outpaced our capacity to run it: business reporting, program delivery and the cross-functional roadmap currently sit with one person alongside the regional strategy agenda. We are building a dedicated capability to own how Asia operates and how Asia delivers, and we want you at the centre of it.

The difference you will make:

This role is based in Singapore and requires regular travel across Asia.

In this role you report to the Senior Business Operations and Growth Lead, Asia and work closely with country Business Operations and Growth Leads across Japan, Korea, India and Southeast Asia, alongside central teams in growth marketing, product, payments, supply, policy and brand. You own the Asia business reporting and operating cadence, and you lead the delivery of the region's growth levers and its cross-functional roadmap.

This is deliberately an ownership role in execution and insight, distinct from the roles around it. Country Business Operations and Growth Leads own their market plans and their outcomes; central growth marketing, product and merchandising build the platforms; Strategic Finance and Advanced Analytics own objective tracking and measurement standards; the regional strategy, partnership and pricing agenda sits with the Senior Lead. You own the connective tissue between them: the reporting that gives the region one accurate and current picture, the delivery of levers into market, the roadmap accountability that keeps cross-functional commitments on track, and the competitive read that tells us where we are gaining and losing.

A typical day:

  • Own the regional business reporting structure, inputs and cadence regionally and globally
  • Lead the end-to-end operations and delivery of selected regional growth levers including go-to-market, measurement and optimization
  • Own the regional view of the cross-functional roadmap across supply, product, payments, policy, brand and growth marketing, and drive accountability on delivery through cross-functional collaboration
  • Own the regional competitive view across both guest and host and enable capabilities locally for country teams for local competitors
  • Synthesize data, trends, guest and host insights, and analysis into actionable recommendations for the regional business
  • Conduct deep dives into operational, programs or functional topics as needed, working with FP&A to assess business performance across areas of strength and weakness
  • Drive entity prioritization and lead entity setup across Asia markets, coordinating with legal, tax, finance and country teams

Your expertise:

  • 10+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting or program management, ideally in a marketplace, consumer technology, hospitality or online travel agency (OTA) environment
  • Experience managing programs or operations across multiple countries with varying levels of maturity, and across time zones
  • A proven track record building and running business operating cadences for a distributed organization: reporting, business reviews, and the follow-through that makes commitments land
  • Exceptional cross-functional orchestration in a heavily matrixed organization, creating clarity where ownership is split across product, growth marketing, payments, supply and country teams
  • Strong operating discipline: cross-workstream roadmaps, launch management, business reviews and executive reporting, and crisp written communication that keeps distributed teams aligned
  • Analytical fluency: comfortable in the numbers, builds the analysis personally, and sets consistent measurement standards with analytics and finance partners (Excel and SQL)
  • Thrives in ambiguity, with a strong bias to action, ownership and ruthless prioritization
  • Fluent written and spoken English; expected in office ~3 days per week
  • Desirable: hands-on experience with one or more growth levers such as incentives, promotions and coupons, host-funded offers, lifecycle and CRM, or merchandising. Familiarity with the business, economic and cultural environments across Asia, and Japanese, Korean or Southeast Asian language skills.

title: Senior Demand Generation Specialist, Hotels (12M FTC)
description:

The Airbnb Hotels organization is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. Airbnb is building the world's largest supply of boutique and independent hotels on its platform. To accelerate that growth, we're hiring a Senior Demand Generation Specialist to own the inbound engine for our Hotels Acquisition team.

This role is remote within France. We are not able to support relocation for this role.

  • Build and scale multi-channel inbound programs (email, paid, SEO, content, events, partnerships) targeting independent hotels, boutique chains, and hotel groups globally

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, marketing automation tools (MixMax, Outreach, or similar), and paid channels
  • Strong analytical, systems-driven approach; comfortable running campaigns yourself, not just briefing others
  • Data-driven: you own your funnel metrics and can connect campaign activity to revenue impact

  • Strong sales alignment instincts; you treat AEs as internal customers

Airbnb Hotels is one of the company's highest-priority supply growth initiatives. This role sits at the center of that effort, with direct visibility to senior leadership and the ability to shape how the world's most recognized travel brand expands into professional hospitality.

As the first person in this role, you'll help show what B2B demand generation can do for Airbnb Hotels. While this is a 12-month fixed-term contract, a successful pilot could lead to the role continuing beyond the initial term.

title: Growth Marketing Lead
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY / Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Growth team helps people discover, adopt, and become successful on Claude. Product managers, engineers, designers, data scientists and marketers work together as one team across every product and plan: Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise, as well as the API for developers. Growth marketing sits within this unified Growth team, and is responsible for performance marketing, lifecycle, and SEO.

We are hiring a Growth Marketing Lead to own and scale our performance marketing efforts. This leader will define channel strategy across self-serve and sales-assisted journeys, develop programs for distinct customer segments, and own measurable impact from demand creation through customer growth.

Key responsibilities

  • Own our global performance marketing channel strategy across all channels, including forecasting, planning, audience targeting, and budget pacing
  • Execute growth campaigns end-to-end across acquisition, activation, and retention, from hypothesis through launch and scale
  • Build campaigns and programs for consumers, developers, and businesses
  • Own self-serve and product-led B2B demand generation for Team, Enterprise and the API, and partner with Enterprise Marketing and GTM on sales-assisted demand
  • Partner closely with Data Science on incrementality, holdouts, attribution, lifetime value and payback
  • Drive experimentation and incrementality measurement, translating results into scalable playbooks across markets, segments, and sales motions
  • Work with Growth Product and Growth Engineering on top-of-funnel experiments, tracking and the marketing stack, so campaigns do not stop at the click
  • Work with Brand, Content and Product Marketing to get high-quality creative out much faster, and take what works in core markets international
  • Turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership, shape the long-term roadmap, and lead and grow the growth marketing team

Minimum qualifications

  • Have 10+ years in growth or performance marketing at high-growth technology companies with a self-serve or product-led motion
  • Have led a growth marketing function, owning the team, budget, and KPIs across multiple channels, and have been hands-on in the work recently
  • Have driven self-serve and product-led B2B demand generation as well as consumer growth, and have partnered well with enterprise marketing and sales teams
  • Are rigorous about experimentation and incrementality, can pull and check your own numbers, and can hold your own with data scientists
  • Reason from first principles, push through blockers and ship, and bring partner teams along while you do it
  • Communicate clearly in writing and can explain marketing performance to non-marketers and executives
  • Technical background or ability to work effectively with engineering teams
  • Already use AI to work faster and better, have a point of view on how it changes growth marketing, and are excited about Anthropic's mission

Preferred qualifications

  • Have marketed to developers or other technical audiences, or worked on an AI product
  • Experience across both SEO and lifecycle, in addition to performance marketing
  • Experience working on products with dual B2C and B2B funnels
  • Experience working on consumer subscription businesses
  • Founder background

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000—$400,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Education Content Marketing Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Education team is building products and programs that advance how people learn with AI. We work across students, educators, institutions, and education communities to help people use AI thoughtfully and effectively.


About the Role

We’re looking for an Education Content Marketing Lead who combines exceptional editorial and curriculum judgment with strong content-marketing instincts, a builder’s mindset, and an engineer’s approach to scale. You’ll create high-quality content and the systems that move it from idea to published asset quickly and consistently.

This is a hands-on role spanning long-form editorial, curriculum, video, visual content, channel strategy, and content operations. You’ll turn strategic briefs and expert input into useful work for students, educators, institutional leaders, and education communities; grow the channels that reach them; and use data to improve both the content and the engine behind it.

Education needs a coherent, measurable content engine across audiences, formats, and channels. This role will turn fragmented requests and one-off production into a prioritized portfolio, reusable workflows, dependable creative capacity, and education-specific channels that compound over time. The goal is not simply to produce more content, but to create work that earns attention, supports learning and engagement, and improves through evidence.


In This Role, You Will

  • Build and continuously improve a scalable content operating system spanning intake, prioritization, resourcing, production, review, publishing, versioning, and reuse.

  • Apply an engineer’s mindset to map dependencies, remove bottlenecks, automate repeatable work, create modular templates and playbooks, and maintain clear quality standards.

  • Maintain a single source of truth for the roadmap, editorial calendar, briefs, source material, production status, approvals, assets, and metadata.

  • Produce and edit content across formats, including long-form articles, blogs, case studies, web and email copy, social posts, educator stories, GIFs, images, and carousels.

  • Develop practical curriculum and professional-learning resources, including lesson plans, educator guides, AI literacy materials, decks, and train-the-trainer content.

  • Lead video development from concept through final cut, including story development, scripting, structural editing, interview preparation, and oversight of production and post-production partners.

  • Own and grow education-specific channels across social, email, websites, and blogs through clear audience strategies, editorial plans, and consistent publishing programs.

  • Set ambitious growth and engagement goals, define measures of content quality and efficacy, instrument tracking, analyze performance, and use experiments to improve results.

  • Turn goals and expert input into clear briefs, plans, timelines, and review paths in partnership with Content, Customer Education, Design, Marketing, Product, Research, Policy, Safety, Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success.

  • Scale production by sourcing, onboarding, and managing a flexible bench of writers, editors, curriculum developers, designers, video partners, agencies, and other vendors.


You Might Thrive In This Role If You

  • Have significant experience in content production, content marketing, editorial leadership, curriculum development, instructional design, or creative production.

  • Bring a strong portfolio demonstrating excellent writing and editing across long-form editorial, curriculum or professional learning, video, social, and visual content.

  • Have built or materially improved content systems, workflows, templates, governance, tooling, automation, or publishing operations.

  • Have owned digital channels and used audience and performance data to set ambitious growth goals, design experiments, and deliver measurable results.

  • Are a strong video storyteller, with experience in scripting, structural editing, interview preparation, and collaboration with production and post-production specialists.

  • Can turn ambiguous, cross-functional input into clear requirements and polished work while sequencing priorities across multiple workstreams.

  • Have experience sourcing and onboarding external partners and are fluent with content-management, digital-asset-management, project-management, analytics, and automation tools.


Nice To Have

  • Experience working in education, edtech, AI, or another technical field.

  • Experience creating both curriculum or professional-learning resources and audience-facing marketing content.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows.

The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn country priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements.

We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets.

We’re looking for a growth lead in Singapore to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with the Singapore GM to understand local users, identify the biggest growth opportunities, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact.   • You will implement plans and evaluate overall efficacy to inform business initiatives
  • You will lead through inspiration, influence, and our core value of belonging

  • You will support the development, execution and scale of pilots to accelerate evolving business verticals
  • Act as a change agent and effectively utilize change management methodologies when deploying solutions and processes.

  • Strong empathy for our community AND passion for revenue and growth
  • Deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models
  • Enthusiastic and creative leader with the ability to inspire others
  • Ability to flourish with minimal guidance, be proactive, and handle uncertainty and ambiguity
  • Expert with Excel (pivot tables, large data set analyses, and formulas), analytical tools (SQL), and methodologies like capacity planning, forecasting, general modeling for prioritization and decision making
  • Comfortable with Google Docs, Salesforce CRM, and other technology solutions for driving supply acquisition, territory management and retention.

  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish, spoken and written is required.

description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll own the visual execution of paid and performance marketing across video, motion, and static formats, producing assets that are on-brand, well art directed and built to convert. You'll report to the Creative Director of Product Marketing.

Your work will directly shape how people first encounter and engage with Runway's products. That means producing scroll-stopping video ads, designing static and animated assets for paid social and display, and using generative tools — including Runway's own — as a core part of how you work. You'll partner closely with product marketing, growth, and creative teams, and you'll be measured on craft, throughput, and performance.

  • Use Runway to ideate, create and iterate on video and image assets that are on-brand and well art directed — not just technically functional

  • Own the visual execution of ad creative from concept through final delivery, working from briefs or generating your own directions when needed

  • Produce motion graphics and animated ads that communicate product value quickly and compellingly

  • Partner with the Product Marketing and growth team to develop integrated ad concepts where copy and design work together

  • Build and iterate on creative variants for A/B and multivariate testing — adapting formats, hooks and visual treatments based on performance data

  • Maintain a consistent visual language across all performance touchpoints without letting assets feel templated or stale

title: Staff Product Manager - Email Marketing
description:

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our Youtube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

HighLevel is accelerating its Email Marketing platform to become the AI-first communication engine for businesses worldwide. We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to transform Email Marketing from a traditional campaign builder into an intelligent, end-to-end campaign creation and automation ecosystem.

Today, HighLevel powers email creation, campaign scheduling, reporting, and lifecycle automation through Email Builder and Sequences. Your mandate is to redefine the customer experience through AI-native creation, intuitive editing interfaces, intelligent lifecycle automation, and actionable campaign intelligence — driving user adoption, activation, engagement, and revenue with a clear, metrics-driven product roadmap.


Key Responsibilities

1. Build World-Class Email Creation Experiences

  • Own the end-to-end Email Builder user experience, including drag-and-drop editors, custom HTML tools, reusable visual components, responsive templates, and real-time collaborative editing.

  • Build an industry-leading AI-native email editor that enables users to generate complete, high-converting email layouts using simple natural language prompts.

  • Lead the evolution of a natural language prompt-to-layout generation ("vibe-code") builder, allowing non-technical marketers to create production-ready emails instantaneously.

  • Deliver native multivariate experimentation tools, including subject line, body copy, layout, and Call-To-Action (CTA) A/B testing to continuously improve conversion rates.

2. Build Intelligent Campaign Delivery & Automation Workflows

  • Own execution and scheduling features, including Send Now, Scheduled Send, Timezone-aware Sending, and AI-powered Send Time Optimization.

  • Scale automated Sequences, trigger logic, dynamic branching, smart personalization fields, and event-driven marketing workflows.

  • Streamline campaign creation workflows to minimize operational complexity for marketers while maximizing end-user engagement.

3. Drive Campaign Intelligence & Customer Insights

  • Build reporting dashboards that accurately measure campaign execution, open/click engagement, conversion rates, attributed revenue, and overall ROI.

  • Deliver actionable, AI-powered recommendations that guide users on how to improve campaign engagement and conversion performance.

  • Establish robust product instrumentation, funnels, and experimentation frameworks to measure feature adoption and product-led outcomes.

4. Build Audience & Preference Management

  • Own subscriber preferences, consent management workflows, and end-user preference centers.

  • Deliver flexible preference experiences that increase customer trust and support global messaging compliance (CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, etc.).

5. Drive Product Strategy & Execution

  • Establish a 12–18 month product roadmap for Email Marketing aligned with HighLevel’s broader product strategy.

  • Conduct continuous customer discovery, competitive analysis, and usability research.

  • Author clear, outcome-focused PRDs and partner closely with Engineering, Product Design, AI, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market teams.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • Formulate a strategic vision and roadmap for the Email Builder and AI-powered campaign lifecycle.

  • Identify and ship initial usability and performance quick-wins in the core Email Builder and Sequence tools based on user feedback and analytics.

  • Establish clear instrumentation and North Star KPIs around activation, campaign creation velocity, and engagement.

  • Align cross-functional Engineering, Design, AI, and GTM teams on upcoming priorities.

First 12 Months

  • Launch Email AI into General Availability (GA) with strong user adoption, drastically reducing campaign creation time.

  • Deploy production-ready natural language prompt-to-layout email generation capabilities.

  • Ship Sequence AI, enabling users to generate multi-touch customer journeys using simple prompts.

  • Expand preference management tools to ensure global compliance and improved subscriber trust.

  • Drive measurable uplift in activation, feature adoption, and campaign success across the HighLevel ecosystem.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, with a background in SaaS product management, email marketing tools, WYSIWYG builders, or marketing automation platforms.

  • Demonstrated success building intuitive, high-adoption end-user tools (editors, drag-and-drop builders, visual canvas tools, or content creation interfaces).

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML integrations, particularly generative text/image tools, prompt engineering workflows, or predictive optimization engines.

  • Strong product craft: proven track record of writing PRDs, mapping user journeys, conducting customer research, and translating complex capabilities into simple UX.

  • Data-fluent mindset: experience defining product instrumentation, running A/B tests, and tracking funnel conversion metrics.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Design, Product, and GTM teams.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with marketing automation workflows, drip campaigns, or lifecycle marketing tools.

  • Background in dynamic content generation, templating systems, or visual design software.

  • Experience designing features for international audiences (localization, multi-language support).
